messages:
meredith: FYI the temporary skybridge at Third & Folsom has a sag from water pooling 10min delay getting past it. People are pausing to take photos. 
tom: Wait the skybridge? oh no. Is it closed? 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Pedestrian bridge at 3rd/Folsom: temporary slowdown due to pooling water and maintenance inspection. Expect foot-traffic delays ~8-15 min. Nearby bike lane open but slow. 
lila: I swapped my usual bike commute for the 22 bus. Took a weird detour but stayed mostly dry. 
athan: (not in office today) 
ryan: I put a spare towel in the lobby under "wet-commute" box if anyone needs it. 
kate: Legend. I'll grab one on my way in. 
meredith: Quick poll: did you switch transport? React :bike: bike, :bus: bus, :train: train, :umbrella: braved it. 
tom: :umbrella: brackets of doom. My hood lost the fight. 
lila: :bus: 
ryan: :bike: skirted the puddles. 
meredith: Also heads up 1st St garage has slow exit because traffic backs up onto Folsom. Consider alternate egress. 
kate: Anyone got a photo of the sag? I need content for mom's group. :camera_with_flash: 
meredith: posted one to #photos channel 1warning: mild puddle horror. 
lila: thanks for the heads up. Bringing an extra pair of socks just in case. 
transit-bot: TransitBot: Muni: minor delays near 3rd/Folsom. BART & Caltrain: unaffected. Tips: avoid standing water, secure laptop bags.
